verdict.rationale: Figma has a well-documented Plugin API supporting read/write access to files, enabling a large ecosystem of plugins (icons, data fillers, accessibility checkers, etc.), plus a Community/marketplace referenced via docs on automating tasks and adding functionality. Community comments confirm real-world plugin usage (e.g., bulk export plugins for icons). missing for 10: no direct evidence of marketplace size/curation, no independent verification of accessibility-checker-type plugins specifically, no hands-on quality review of plugin ecosystem breadth.
